theorems.name: Submission.dmr_measureRepresentation_unique
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl N)) (v₁ v₂ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsMeasureRepresentation X μ₁ v₁ → IsMeasureRepresentation X μ₂ v₂ → (∀ A : Set (Eucl N), MeasurableSet A → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∫ x in A, v₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in A, v₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x) ∂μ₂) ∧ (∀ A : Set (Eucl N), MeasurableSet A → Bornology.IsBounded A → ∀ α : Covector (Eucl N) k, ∫ x in A, v₁ x α ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in A, v₂ x α ∂μ₂)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
